Track reading stats, set goals, and grow your fluency — all in a calm, distraction-free environment.

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.subheading: Everything you need to know about TextStack.

whatIs.a: TextStack is a free reading platform for language learners. Read classic English books with built-in translation, vocabulary flashcards, text-to-speech, and reading statistics — all in one app.

isFree.a: Yes. The full catalog, reader, translation, SRS flashcards, and reading statistics are completely free. No credit card required, no hidden limits.

languages.a: You can translate English text into 18+ languages including Spanish, French, German, Ukrainian, Japanese, Korean, Chinese, Portuguese, and more. The interface is available in English and Ukrainian.

tapTranslate.a: While reading, simply tap or click any word. You will instantly see the translation in your native language, a dictionary definition, and can hear the pronunciation. No switching apps or copying text.

uploadBooks.q: Can I upload my own books?
uploadBooks.a: Absolutely. Upload EPUB, PDF, or FB2 files and read them with the full TextStack toolkit — translation, flashcards, TTS, and progress tracking.

srsCards.q: How do the SRS flashcards work?
srsCards.a: When you save a word, it becomes an SRS flashcard. The system uses 5 stages — from Recognition to Mastered — spacing reviews so you remember long-term. Smart distractors make each review meaningful.

offline.a: Yes. Download books for offline reading. Your progress, bookmarks, and vocabulary sync automatically when you reconnect.

mobileApp.a: A mobile app for iOS and Android is in active development and coming soon. In the meantime, TextStack works great on mobile browsers.

vsFriends.q: How is TextStack different from Kindle or LingQ?
vsFriends.a: TextStack combines the reading experience of Kindle with the language-learning tools of LingQ — and it is free. Tap-to-translate, SRS flashcards, built-in text-to-speech, offline reading, and detailed statistics, all in one clean reader.

about.seoDesc: TextStack Reader helps you learn languages through reading real books. Built-in vocabulary, spaced repetition, and reading stats — all in a calm, distraction-free environment.
about.title: About
about.intro: TextStack Reader is a reading platform that helps you build real language fluency — through books, not flashcards.
about.body1: We offer thousands of classic and public-domain books with a clean, distraction-free reading experience. But TextStack Reader goes beyond a library: look up words as you read, save them to your vocabulary, and review with spaced repetition. Track your reading stats, set goals, and watch your fluency grow.
about.mission1: Real fluency comes from deep, consistent exposure to real texts — not micro-exercises. TextStack Reader is built around this principle: reading is the core learning engine.
about.mission2: Every feature — vocabulary builder, reading stats, text-to-speech, translation — exists to support one goal: help you become more fluent through reading.

creator.heading: The Creator
creator.bio1: I built TextStack Reader because I believe reading is the most natural way to learn a language — and that great literature should be the fuel, not a textbook.
creator.bio2: This is a long-term passion project. If you share this vision or want to connect, I'd love to hear from you.

privacy.seoDesc: TextStack Reader privacy policy. We collect minimal data and respect your privacy. No accounts required for reading.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Your privacy matters. TextStack Reader is designed to let you read freely without surveillance or data harvesting.
privacy.collectBody1: TextStack Reader collects minimal data. You can browse and read any book in our library without creating an account or providing personal information.
privacy.collectBody2: If you choose to use optional features like saving reading progress or bookmarks, this data is stored locally in your browser. We do not track what you read or share this information with third parties.
privacy.cookiesBody1: We use essential cookies only to remember your preferences (like dark mode settings). We do not use advertising cookies or tracking pixels.
privacy.cookiesBody2: Basic analytics may be collected to understand general usage patterns and improve the service, but this data is anonymized and not linked to individual users.
privacy.thirdPartiesBody: We do not sell, rent, or share your personal information with third parties. We do not display advertisements or use third-party tracking services.
privacy.storageBody1: Reading preferences, progress, and bookmarks are stored locally in your browser using standard web storage APIs. You can clear this data at any time through your browser settings.
privacy.storageBody2: If you upload personal books to your library, these files are stored securely and are only accessible to you.
privacy.rightsBody: You have the right to access, correct, or delete any personal data we may hold. Since we collect minimal data, there's usually nothing to delete — but if you have questions, please contact us.
privacy.contactBody: If you have questions about this privacy policy, please reach out at
